minimumMissingWitnesses.nullification-wave: Bind one exact authorized continuing permanent item enhancement or innate magical manifestation, distinguish the ongoing expression from intrinsic item/creature/class entitlement, identify the legal actor/acquisition/owner/custodian and operative state, and supply any explicit protection and source-owned ending/remainder/recreation contract. Then demonstrate a paid 26-RP Wave (actual final price/cadence), immutable geometry/capture, no-save component ending, remaining mundane body/contents/custody and attempted subsequent use with no invented repair, refund or identity deletion. Missing campaign possession alone remains conditional; the continuing-property classification and required positive terminal history are the whole-identity gate.
minimumMissingWitnesses.reality-anchor: Bind an actual continuing unique/item/innate magical component and its applicable suppression/lifecycle contract, legal access/acquisition/owner/custody and operative-use history. Demonstrate actual Permission-mode deny/allow with a known source handle, retained spent uses/contents and absolute clock, source expiry/ending while denied, and only still-live expression resuming without refill or recreation. If asserting Transmutation-mode treatment of that component, additionally bind its actual generating Transmutation classification; do not infer it from appearance. A finite inscription alone must not be presented as proof of the unsourced permanent entitlement contract.

scopeLimitation: Crosschecks sealed package and authority fields; the game-rule adjudication remains the Director's ruling.
